root_cause.source_defect: Recount uses raw CPU-kind enum values as array indices but sizes allocations using popcount of represented kinds. E-only means index 1 and allocation count 1.
source_evidence: revisions/001 kernel recount.c:151-179 maps CLUSTER_TYPE_E to RCT_CPU_EFFICIENCY, computes popcount, and uses that count to size both usage and track zones.
osfmk/kern/recount.h:51,84-92 defines two kinds with P=0 and E=1; recount.c recount_topo_index and recount_convert_topo_index return the raw enum.
recount_update_start indexes tracks directly and updates rt_sync; recount_absorb_snap adds per-thread time/instruction/cycle accounting, then unlock increments rt_sync again.
recount.h:134-149 places rt_pad at 0, rt_sync at 4, then kernel time/instruction/cycle fields at 8/16/24 in this build. The observed corruption has exactly that shape.
Actual linked recount_startup retains E=1 and compiled popcount; this is not merely an unselected source branch.
The allocation backtrace detects a modified free slot. It does not establish that a previously freed thread itself was accessed; an out-of-bounds neighboring track update explains the same detector.
root_cause.confidence: Definite source indexing/allocation bug for the observed one-Icestorm guest, strongly explaining the observed corruption. The individual earlier writing thread was not traced.

revision002.allocation_fix: Allocate highest represented CPU-kind index plus one, preserving enum semantics and zero holes. P-only=1 slot, E-only=2 slots, P+E=2 slots. Empty/invalid spans still fail validation.
revision002.api_fix: proc_pidthreadcounts also clamps the exported count to actual performance levels, matching _selfcounts_perf_level. E-only exports one level sourced from E slot 1.
unchanged: Recount accounting and normal allocation/free paths

host_checks.cases: P-only, E-only, P+E with 1..4 CPUs per represented kind; raw enum identity, slot count, untouched free neighbor, zero holes, both exported level counts and level-to-kind mapping. Empty and unknown topology refusal also checked.
host_checks.source_binding: Host harness compiles extracted actual startup prefix, topology-index function, perf-level mapping, export count expressions and recount track structure.
host_checks.mutation: Restoring popcount passes P-only/P+E but fails the E-only neighboring-free-slot sentinel check.
